stem:
Meena's school in Nagpur held a health check-up week. The teacher asked the class to decide who among the following students can be called truly healthy. Whose situation shows complete health ( )
A. Arjun has no disease, but he feels lonely, sleeps poorly, and avoids his classmates
B. Kavya is free from illness, eats balanced food, stays cheerful, and shares a good bond with her friends and family
C. Ravi has strong muscles and wins races, so he must be healthy even though he often quarrels with everyone
D. Sana has no fever or cough this month, so nothing else needs to be checked

options.text: Arjun has no disease, but he feels lonely, sleeps poorly, and avoids his classmates
Kavya is free from illness, eats balanced food, stays cheerful, and shares a good bond with her friends and family
Ravi has strong muscles and wins races, so he must be healthy even though he often quarrels with everyone
Sana has no fever or cough this month, so nothing else needs to be checked

teacher.key_rationale: Health means complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. Only Kavya shows all three dimensions: she is disease-free and well-nourished (physical), cheerful (mental), and has good relationships (social). Arjun lacks mental and social well-being, Ravi lacks social well-being despite physical strength, and Sana is judged only on absence of disease, which is insufficient.
